evidence: Modifies src/wallet/rpc/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.cpp to improve descriptor and HD key management.
rationale: Improves RPC ergonomics by allowing createwalletdescriptor to auto-detect an unused HD key instead of requiring manual copy-pasting from gethdkeys. This provides a clear usability improvement for scripted descriptor wallet setups, but does not impact fund safety or fix a critical bug.
